record.one_liner: Asana offers a comprehensive REST API and app components framework supporting OAuth 2.0, personal access tokens, and service accounts for project management integrations.

auth_methods.quote: Personal access token (PAT) ... OAuth is an open-standard authentication protocol ... OpenID Connect (OIDC) is an open authentication protocol that works on top of the OAuth 2.0.

access_test.quote: We recommend building test apps in a developer sandbox

access_ship.quote: Once the app is published to Asana's app directory, apps can also be installed directly from the app directory.

api_type.quote: The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON or form-encoded requests, returns JSON

api_breadth.quote: contains a comprehensive reference for objects, schemas, and endpoints available in the API
